definition: Exposure-structure feature subset: primary P3 features explicitly measuring free-text exposure and subsequent action structure.
selection_rule: Include only the six primary features in the frozen P3 feature schema group exposure_structure. No label, model, split, suite, ID, group, attacker-goal, evaluator-outcome, or raw-text fields are included.
caveat: This is the operational P4 definition adopted for this pipeline, based on the frozen P3 schema's exposure_structure group. Review it as a research-design decision before interpreting V_exp as a causal measure; it is an exposure-structure subset, not proof of attention or causal compliance.
